name: origin-ui-input
blurb: Lightweight input field with focus ring and validation styling.
description: A minimal input component extending standard HTML input attributes with theme-aware Tailwind styling, focus indicators, and aria-invalid error states.
use_when: Building accessible forms with consistent, minimal input styling across different input types.
avoid_when: When decorative or specialized input variants with animations are needed.
a11y: Fully semantic HTML; respects aria-invalid for error states and includes proper focus-visible styling.
